newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - READING & BATES EPS CUT.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - READING & BATES EPS CUT.

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it cut its third quarter earnings estimate for Reading & Bates Corp to $0.28 a share from $0.55 and its 1997 estimate to $1.51 a share from $1.78.

-- Rodman said it cut estimates to reflect unsuccessful wells. Reading & Bates, which acquires interests in offshore oil and gas properties, said its Reading & Bates Development Co subsidiary participated in three unsuccessful exploratory wells that were completed in July.
-- "Despite lowering our Q3 and 1997 earnings estimates, Reading & Bates shares remain attractive longer term, pending its merger with Falcon Drilling," Rodman said in a report.
